directions.label: Marketplace hero
directions.purpose: Win the click: clean seamless background, soft contact shadow, no props.
directions.scene: a clean seamless sweep in a soft neutral tone, a soft contact shadow, no props
directions.composition: the product centered at a slight three-quarter angle, filling most of the frame

directions.label: In-use mockup
directions.purpose: Show it where the customer actually uses it, product still the hero.
directions.scene: in use at {use}, doing its job, with the everyday objects that belong there
directions.composition: eye level or slightly above, the product sharp and unmistakably the hero, its surroundings readable

directions.label: Lifestyle scene
directions.purpose: Place it in an aspirational styled setting that sells the feeling.
directions.scene: an aspirational, lived-in setting at {use}, styled to sell the feeling
directions.composition: a wider styled shot, the product the clear focal point and the props secondary

directions.label: Material detail
directions.purpose: Macro on texture and finish to prove craft and justify the price.
directions.scene: a macro close-up of the material, texture and edges, nothing else in the frame
directions.composition: a tight macro crop on the finish, {surface}, shallow depth of field; any words on the product whole inside the frame (or one whole word on purpose), never cut at the frame's edge
directions.lighting: raking side light that reveals the texture

directions.label: Packaging / gift
directions.purpose: Show it gift-ready to trigger Etsy gift-buying.
directions.scene: gift-ready: the product with gift packaging (a box, tissue paper, a ribbon or a gift tag) on a simple surface
directions.composition: the product and its packaging arranged together, the product in front and unmistakable
